name: Westmorland and Furness
description: Westmorland and Furness is a ceremonial county created in 2023 covering the southern and eastern parts of the former Cumbria area. It includes Barrow-in-Furness, Kendal and much of the Lake District, making it one of England's most mountainous and scenic regions.

places.name: Barrow-in-Furness
places.description: A shipbuilding town on Cumbria's coast, historically central to Britain's submarine manufacturing, still home to BAE Systems' shipyards today.

places.name: Eden District
places.description: A rural district in Cumbria named for the River Eden, covering the market town of Penrith and the wild Pennine landscape of the North Pennines.

places.name: South Lakeland
places.description: A district covering much of the southern Lake District, including Windermere, England's largest natural lake, and the market town of Kendal.
